title: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.Descends
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: Fix a prime ℓ, a number field L₀ and an element γ of its absolute Galois group. Descent means that for every natural e ≥ 1 and m ≥ 0 and every number field L₁ over L₀ satisfying the layer condition IsLayer(ℓ,m,L₀,L₁), one has shaInv(L₁,ℓ,e) = cokerLen(T^(ℓᵐ) − 1), where T is the e-twisted action xTw(ℓ,ℓ,⊤,e,γ) for the full absolute Galois group of L₀.
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean: def Descends (γ : G L₀ (AlgebraicClosure L₀)) : Prop
source: def Descends (γ : G L₀ (AlgebraicClosure L₀)) : Prop :=
∀ e : ℕ, 1 ≤ e → ∀ (m : ℕ) (L₁ : Type) [Field L₁] [NumberField L₁] [Algebra L₀ L₁], IsLayer l m L₀ L₁ →
shaInv L₁ l e = cokerLen (xTw l l (⊤ : Subgroup (G L₀ (AlgebraicClosure L₀))) e γ ^ l ^ m - 1)

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.subject: Global fields, idèles and class groups
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: Fix a prime ℓ and an algebraic closure Ω of a number field k. If γ ∈ Gal(Ω/k) satisfies ℓ ∣ χℓ(γ) − 1 in ℤℓ, then γ lies in the level-one subgroup levU(ℓ,Gal(Ω/k),1), the kernel of the cyclotomic character reduced modulo ℓ.
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean:
theorem mem_levU_one {k Ω : Type} [Field k] [NumberField k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [IsAlgClosure k Ω] {γ : G k Ω}
    (h : (l : ℤ_[l]) ∣ (cycZ k Ω l γ : ℤ_[l]) - 1) : γ ∈ levU l (⊤ : Subgroup (G k Ω)) 1

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.cokLen
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: For a ℤℓ-linear endomorphism f of X, its cokernel length is the ℤℓ-module length of X/f(X), valued in the natural numbers extended by infinity.
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean: def cokLen (f : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) : ℕ∞
source: def cokLen (f : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) : ℕ∞ := Module.length ℤ_[l] (X ⧸ LinearMap.range f)

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.twLen
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: For a ℤℓ-linear endomorphism γ, a scalar u in ℤℓ, and naturals e and m, the twisted length is the ℤℓ-length of the cokernel of (uᵉγ)^(ℓᵐ) − 1.
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean: def twLen (γ : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) (u : ℤ_[l]) (e m : ℕ) : ℕ∞
source: def twLen (γ : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) (u : ℤ_[l]) (e m : ℕ) : ℕ∞ := cokLen ((u ^ e • γ) ^ l ^ m - 1)

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.Descends.eq_twLen
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.subject: Galois and profinite cohomology
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: Fix a prime ℓ and a number field L₀. Suppose γ in the absolute Galois group of L₀ satisfies descent. For every natural e ≥ 1, every natural m, and every number field L₁ over L₀ satisfying IsLayer(ℓ,m,L₀,L₁), one has shaInv(L₁,ℓ,e) = twLen(A,χℓ(γ),e,m). Here A is the action of γ under xRep for the full absolute Galois group, and the cyclotomic unit χℓ(γ) is viewed in ℤℓ.

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: An endomorphism γ of a ℤℓ-module X is unipotent modulo ℓ in the specified sense when there is a natural N such that (γ − 1)ᴺ sends every element of X into ℓX.

source: def Unip (γ : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) : Prop := ∃ N : ℕ, InPow 1 ((γ - 1) ^ N)

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.dualUnip
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.subject: Automorphic representations, trace formulae and theta lifting
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: Let D be a ℤℓ-module with finitely generated dual D* = Hom(D,ℚℓ/ℤℓ). Suppose g acts linearly on D, t acts on D* by precomposition with g, and for every φ ∈ D some power of g − 1 kills φ. Then some power of t − 1 maps D* into ℓD*.
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.dualUnip :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (D : Type) [AddCommGroup D] [Module ℤ_[l] D] (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] D) (t : Module.End ℤ_[l] (D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l)),
      Module.Finite ℤ_[l] (D →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] QZ l) → (∀ x φ, t x φ = x (g φ)) → (∀ φ : D, ∃ k : ℕ, ((g - 1) ^ k) φ = 0) → Unip t

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.xUnip
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.subject: Global fields, idèles and class groups
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: Let U be a closed normal subgroup of the absolute Galois group of a number field with chosen algebraic closure. Fix ℓ prime and N natural. If the corresponding module X∞ is finitely generated over the ℓ-adic integers, every level-one element γ of U acts on X∞ unipotently modulo ℓ.
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.xUnip :
    ∀ (k Ω : Type) [Field k] [NumberField k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [IsAlgClosure k Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (N : ℕ)
      (U : Subgroup (G k Ω)) [U.Normal], IsClosed (U : Set (G k Ω)) → Module.Finite ℤ_[l] (Xinf l N U) →
      ∀ γ ∈ levU l U 1, Unip (xRep l N U γ)

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: Assume global Poitou–Tate duality, local finiteness and local Tate duality. For a number field F with an algebraic closure, a prime ℓ satisfying the required Poitou–Tate case, any allowed local data D and integer twist e, the first locally trivial cohomology length is at most the indicated second cohomology length.

theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.shaLeV :

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.IsLevel
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: An ℓ-adic integer u has level c when vℓ(u − 1) is exactly the natural number c, c ≥ 1, and ℓ = 2 implies c ≥ 2. In particular the stipulated valuation is finite.
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean: def IsLevel (u : ℤ_[l]) (c : ℕ) : Prop
source: def IsLevel (u : ℤ_[l]) (c : ℕ) : Prop := vl l (u - 1) = c ∧ 1 ≤ c ∧ (l = 2 → 2 ≤ c)

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.lteNorm
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.subject: Divisibility, congruences and arithmetic functions
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: Let the prime ℓ and the ℓ-adic integer u satisfy the level-c condition. Then u has norm one and u−1 is divisible by ℓ. For all natural j, a and b, the distance between the a-th and b-th powers of u raised to ℓʲ is ℓ to the power −(j+c) times the distance between a and b in the ℓ-adic integers.
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.lteNorm :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (u : ℤ_[l]) (c : ℕ), IsLevel l u c → ‖u‖ = 1 ∧ (l : ℤ_[l]) ∣ u - 1 ∧
      ∀ j a b : ℕ, ‖(u ^ l ^ j) ^ a - (u ^ l ^ j) ^ b‖ = ((l : ℝ) ^ (j + c))⁻¹ * ‖(a : ℤ_[l]) - b‖

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: vl_prod

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.normVal
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.subject: Divisibility, congruences and arithmetic functions
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: Let ℓ be prime, let c and R be natural numbers, and let d and an R-element indexed family (xᵢ) be given in ℤℓ. If ∏ᵢ(ℓ^(−c)‖xᵢ‖)≤‖d‖, then vℓ(d)≤Σᵢ(c+vℓ(xᵢ)), with values in the extended natural numbers.
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.normVal :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (R c : ℕ) (d : ℤ_[l]) (x : Fin R → ℤ_[l]),
      ∏ i, (((l : ℝ) ^ c)⁻¹ * ‖x i‖) ≤ ‖d‖ → vl l d ≤ ∑ i, ((c : ℕ∞) + vl l (x i))

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.GenBy
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: For a natural R and a ℤℓ-module X, generation by R elements means there exists a surjective ℤℓ-linear map from ℤℓᴿ to X.
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean: def GenBy (R : ℕ) (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] : Prop

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.lift
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.subject: Matrices, determinants and linear algebra
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: Let X be a ℤℓ-module generated by R elements and let g be a ℤℓ-linear endomorphism. There exists an R-by-R matrix S over ℤℓ such that for every c in ℤℓ, the cokernel length of cg−I is at most the extended additive valuation of det(cS−I).
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.lift :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (R : ℕ) (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] X), GenBy l R X →
      ∃ S : Matrix (Fin R) (Fin R) ℤ_[l], ∀ c : ℤ_[l], cokLen (c • g - 1) ≤ vl l (c • S - 1).det

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: padic_units_distance_le_max
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.subject: p-adic arithmetic and power series
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: For ℓ-adic integers a and b of norm one and any z in the algebraic closure of the ℓ-adics, the distance between a and b is at most the larger of the distances of az and bz from one, with a and b embedded in the closure.
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean:
private theorem padic_units_distance_le_max (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (a b : ℤ_[l]) (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (hb : ‖b‖ = 1)
    (z : PadicAlgCl l) :
    ‖a - b‖ ≤ max ‖algebraMap ℚ_[l] (PadicAlgCl l) (a : ℚ_[l]) * z - 1‖
      ‖algebraMap ℚ_[l] (PadicAlgCl l) (b : ℚ_[l]) * z - 1‖

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.helly
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.subject: Divisibility, congruences and arithmetic functions
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: Let ℓ be prime. For a sequence of ℓ-adic integers xₐ and real radii rₐ, suppose the distance between any two centres is at most the larger radius. Then there is an ℓ-adic integer s with distance at most rₐ from every xₐ.
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.helly :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (x : ℕ → ℤ_[l]) (r : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ a b, ‖x a - x b‖ ≤ max (r a) (r b)) →
      ∃ s : ℤ_[l], ∀ a, ‖s - x a‖ ≤ r a

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.ball
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.subject: p-adic arithmetic and power series
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: Let ℓ be prime and let u in ℤℓ have level c. For every natural j and every z in the algebraic closure of ℚℓ there is a centre s in ℤℓ such that ℓ^(−(j+c))‖s−e‖ ≤ ‖(u^(ℓʲ))ᵉz−1‖ for every natural e. The factor involving u on the right is embedded in that algebraic closure.
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.ball :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (u : ℤ_[l]) (c : ℕ), IsLevel l u c → ∀ (j : ℕ) (z : PadicAlgCl l), ∃ s : ℤ_[l], ∀ e : ℕ,
      ((l : ℝ) ^ (j + c))⁻¹ * ‖s - e‖ ≤ ‖algebraMap ℚ_[l] (PadicAlgCl l) (((u ^ l ^ j) ^ e : ℤ_[l]) : ℚ_[l]) * z - 1‖

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.detFactor
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.subject: Matrices, determinants and linear algebra
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: For every algebraically closed field K and every square matrix S of order n over K there are z₁,…,zₙ in K such that for every c ∈ K, det(cS − I) = ∏ᵢ(czᵢ − 1). Multiplicities are included.
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.detFactor :
    ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] (n : ℕ) (S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K),
      ∃ z : Fin n → K, ∀ c : K, (c • S - 1).det = ∏ i, (c * z i - 1)

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.detBound
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.subject: Matrices, determinants and linear algebra
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: Let ℓ be prime, u ∈ ℤℓ have level c, and j,R be natural numbers. For every R by R matrix S over ℤℓ there exist R centres sᵢ in ℤℓ such that, for every natural e, vℓ(det((u^(ℓʲ))ᵉ S − I)) ≤ Σᵢ(j + c + vℓ(sᵢ − e)).
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.detBound :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (u : ℤ_[l]) (c : ℕ), IsLevel l u c → ∀ (j R : ℕ) (S : Matrix (Fin R) (Fin R) ℤ_[l]),
      ∃ s : Fin R → ℤ_[l], ∀ e : ℕ, vl l ((u ^ l ^ j) ^ e • S - 1).det ≤ ∑ i, (((j + c : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + vl l (s i - e))

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.exists_centres_level
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.subject: Divisibility, congruences and arithmetic functions
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: Fix a layer j and a ℤℓ-linear endomorphism γ of a module generated by R elements. If u ∈ ℤℓ has level c, then there are R centres sᵢ ∈ ℤℓ such that the twisted length at (e,j) is at most Σᵢ(j + c + vℓ(sᵢ − e)) for every natural e.
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean:
theorem exists_centres_level {R c : ℕ} (γ : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) {u : ℤ_[l]} (hX : GenBy l R X) (hu : IsLevel l u c) (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ s : Fin R → ℤ_[l], ∀ e : ℕ, twLen γ u e j ≤ ∑ i, (((j + c : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + vl l (s i - e))

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.twist
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.subject: Automorphic representations, trace formulae and theta lifting
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: If g is unipotent modulo ℓ on an ℓ-adic module and the scalar a is congruent to one modulo ℓ, then ag is also unipotent modulo ℓ.
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.twist :
    ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) (a : ℤ_[l]), (l : ℤ_[l]) ∣ a - 1 →

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.name: nilLen_range_succ
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.subject: Matrices, determinants and linear algebra
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: For an endomorphism f of a module over a commutative ring and any natural k, the image of f raised to k+1 is the image under f of the range of fᵏ.

private theorem nilLen_range_succ {A M : Type} [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
    (f : Module.End A M) (k : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.range (f ^ (k + 1)) = (LinearMap.range (f ^ k)).map f

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.subject: Matrices, determinants and linear algebra
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: For a nilpotent endomorphism f of a module over a commutative ring, if fᵏ is nonzero then the image of f to the power k+1 is properly contained in the image of fᵏ.

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.subject: Commutative algebra, ideals and modules
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: If a nilpotent endomorphism f acts on a module of composition length at most the natural number n, its n-th power is zero.
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.nilLen :
    ∀ (A M : Type) [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] (f : Module.End A M) (n : ℕ), IsNilpotent f →
      Module.length A M ≤ n → f ^ n = 0

Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.subject: Matrices, determinants and linear algebra
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.statement: For every prime ℓ, natural R, and ℤℓ-module X generated by at most R elements, the ℤℓ-length of X/ℓX is at most R.
Development.AutomorphicArithmetic.Automo.lean:
theorem UpperTheory.V.PropA.cokL :

imports.statement: The one-units of a local ring are the units u for which u − 1 belongs to the maximal ideal. The source gives the subgroup laws explicitly.

def oneUnits : Subgroup Oˣ where
  carrier := {u | (u : O) - 1 ∈ maximalIdeal O}
  one_mem' := by simp
  mul_mem' {a b} ha hb := by
    have := (maximalIdeal O).add_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_right (b : O) _ ha) hb
    simpa [sub_mul] using this
  inv_mem' {a} ha := by
    have := (maximalIdeal O).neg_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_right ((a⁻¹ : Oˣ) : O) _ ha)
    simpa [sub_mul] using this

theorem exists_qz_ne_zero_annihilators_of_ne_zero (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ_[l] M]
    (m : M) (hm : m ≠ 0) : ∃ x : QZ l, x ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a : ℤ_[l], a • m = 0 → a • x = 0

imports.name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.shaDGen
imports.statement: If U is closed normal, V ≤ U and the cyclotomic character of γ topologically generates the image of V with γ ∈ V, the V-invariants in twisted D∞ equal ker(dTw(γ) − 1) and also ker(dTw(γ⁻¹) − 1).
imports.lean:
theorem UpperTheory.V.Tower.shaDGen :
    ∀ (k Ω : Type) [Field k] [NumberField k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [IsAlgClosure k Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (N : ℕ) (U V : Subgroup (G k Ω)) [U.Normal] (e : ℤ) (γ : G k Ω), IsClosed (U : Set (G k Ω)) → V ≤ U → IsGen l V γ →
        ShaD l N U V e = LinearMap.ker (dTw l N U e γ - 1) ∧ ShaD l N U V e = LinearMap.ker (dTw l N U e γ⁻¹ - 1)

imports.name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.cZero
imports.statement: c₀ is the supremum in ℕ of the exponents c for which the base field contains a primitive ℓᶜ-th root. In its number-field application the set has a largest element and muQ characterizes it. The root of order one accounts for c = 0.
imports.lean: def cZero : ℕ

imports.name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.layU
imports.statement: The subgroup of the m-th layer is the congruence subgroup of the full Galois group at c₀ + m. Thus the shift by the roots already in the base field precedes the layer index.
imports.lean: abbrev layU (m : ℕ) : Subgroup (G L Ω)

imports.name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.layF
imports.statement: The canonical m-th layer is the field obtained by adjoining all ℓ^(c₀ + m)-th roots of unity to the base field in the chosen closure.
imports.lean: abbrev layF (m : ℕ) : IntermediateField L Ω

imports.name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.XP
imports.statement: XP is the algebraic dual of the character module for the full absolute Galois group, with the splitting parameter N = ℓ and the algebraic closure chosen canonically.
imports.lean: abbrev XP : Type

imports.name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.IsTower
imports.statement: The tower structure records four pieces of data about the base number field L and the prime ℓ. The field is totally complex, it has the prescribed initial root of unity, R ≥ 1, and a free ℤℓ-module on R generators surjects onto XP. The definition carries the generator bound directly.
imports.lean:
structure IsTower (R : ℕ) : Prop where
  complex : IsTotallyComplex L
  mu : HasMuQ l L
  pos : 1 ≤ R
  gen : GenLE ℤ_[l] (XP l L) R

imports.name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.GenLE.finite
imports.statement: A module admitting a surjection from Rⁿ is finitely generated.
imports.lean:
theorem GenLE.finite {R M : Type} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {n : ℕ} (h : GenLE R M n) :
    Module.Finite R M

imports.name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.cokerLen
imports.statement: For an endomorphism T of a module M over a commutative ring R, cokerLen is the extended length of the quotient M/T(M). Specializing R to ℤℓ gives the cokernel length in the operator model.
imports.lean: def cokerLen {R M : Type} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (T : Module.End R M) : ℕ∞

imports.name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.IsGen
imports.statement: γ belongs to U and the cyclotomic image of U lies in the topological closure of the integer powers of κ(γ). This asks for generation of the character image. The subgroup U itself can have a large kernel.
imports.lean: def IsGen (γ : G k Ω) : Prop

imports.name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.dRep
imports.statement: The discrete action on D∞ is the restriction of the conjugation action on all ℚℓ/ℤℓ-valued functions to the stable submodule of allowed characters.
imports.lean: def dRep : Representation ℤ_[l] (G k Ω) (Dinf l N U)

imports.name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.xRep
imports.statement: G acts on Homℤℓ(D∞,ℚℓ/ℤℓ) through its action on D∞ and the trivial action on the target. Thus g sends x to the functional φ ↦ x(g⁻¹φ).
imports.lean: def xRep : Representation ℤ_[l] (G k Ω) (Xinf l N U)

imports.name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.xRep_apply
imports.statement: Evaluating the dual action gives (g x)(φ) = x(g⁻¹φ).
imports.lean: theorem xRep_apply (g : G k Ω) (x : Xinf l N U) (φ : Dinf l N U) : xRep l N U g x φ = x (dRep l N U g⁻¹ φ)

imports.name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.dTw
imports.statement: Twist the conjugation action on D∞ by the character κ⁻ᵉ. The exponent is the negative of the integer parameter e.
imports.lean: def dTw (e : ℤ) : Representation ℤ_[l] (G k Ω) (Dinf l N U)

imports.name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.xTw
imports.statement: Twist the contragredient action on X∞ by κᵉ. Thus the operator attached to g is κ(g)ᵉ times the untwisted action of g, also for negative integer e.
imports.lean: def xTw (e : ℤ) : Representation ℤ_[l] (G k Ω) (Xinf l N U)

imports.name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.xTw_apply
imports.statement: The twisted operator on X∞ at g is the product of its untwisted action with the scalar κ(g)ᵉ in ℤℓ.
imports.lean:
theorem xTw_apply (e : ℤ) (g : G k Ω) :
    xTw l N U e g = ((cycZ k Ω l g ^ e : ℤ_[l]ˣ) : ℤ_[l]) • xRep l N U g

imports.name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.xTw_apply_apply
imports.statement: Twisted evaluation is equivariant in the form (xTw(e,g)x)(φ) = x(dTw(e,g⁻¹)φ).
imports.lean:
theorem xTw_apply_apply (e : ℤ) (g : G k Ω) (x : Xinf l N U) (φ : Dinf l N U) :
    xTw l N U e g x φ = x (dTw l N U e g⁻¹ φ)

imports.name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.ShaD
imports.statement: ShaD consists of the characters in D∞ fixed by the e-twisted action of every element of V, with the action restricted along the subgroup inclusion.
imports.lean: abbrev ShaD (e : ℤ) : Submodule ℤ_[l] (Dinf l N U)

imports.name: UpperTheory.V.IsLift
imports.statement: An automorphism σ of Ω lifts τ of F if it takes the embedded x to the embedded τ(x) for every x in F.
imports.lean: def IsLift (τ : F ≃+* F) (σ : Ω ≃+* Ω) : Prop

imports.name: KStar.Selmer.H2
imports.statement: For a matrix Φ over R with finitely many columns, H2(Φ) in the matrix namespace is the quotient of the target coordinate module by the range of matrix multiplication on column vectors.
imports.lean: abbrev H2 [Fintype n] (Φ : Matrix m n R) : Type _

imports.name: KStar.Selmer.length_cokernel_eq_addVal_det
imports.statement: For a square matrix over a discrete valuation ring, the length of its cokernel is the additive valuation of its determinant, including infinity when the determinant is zero.
imports.lean:
theorem length_cokernel_eq_addVal_det (Φ : Matrix n n O) :
    Module.length O (H2 Φ) = IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal O Φ.det

imports.name: KStar.TotallyRealRoots.emultiplicity_pow_sub_one_odd
imports.statement: For odd prime ℓ, u ≡ 1 modulo ℓ and natural n, the extended multiplicity of ℓ in uⁿ − 1 equals its multiplicity in u − 1 plus its multiplicity in n.
imports.lean:
theorem emultiplicity_pow_sub_one_odd (hl : l ≠ 2) {u : ℤ_[l]} (hu : (l : ℤ_[l]) ∣ u - 1) (n : ℕ) :
    emultiplicity (l : ℤ_[l]) (u ^ n - 1) =
      emultiplicity (l : ℤ_[l]) (u - 1) + emultiplicity l n

imports.name: KStar.TotallyRealRoots.emultiplicity_pow_sub_one_sq
imports.statement: If u ≡ 1 modulo ℓ², the same multiplicity identity holds for every natural exponent and every prime ℓ, including two.
imports.lean:
theorem emultiplicity_pow_sub_one_sq {u : ℤ_[l]} (hu : (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ 2 ∣ u - 1) (n : ℕ) :
    emultiplicity (l : ℤ_[l]) (u ^ n - 1) =
      emultiplicity (l : ℤ_[l]) (u - 1) + emultiplicity l n

imports.name: KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ_le_of_isClosed
imports.statement: A closed subgroup of ℤℓ-units containing an element u of exact level a contains every principal unit of level at least a, provided a ≥ 1 and a ≥ 2 at two.

imports.name: KStar.TotallyRealRoots.redPow
imports.statement: Reduction modulo ℓᵃ takes ℤℓ-units to units of ℤ/ℓᵃ by the unit homomorphism induced by the residue map.
imports.lean: def redPow (a : ℕ) : ℤ_[l]ˣ →* (ZMod (l ^ a))ˣ

imports.name: KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ
imports.statement: The principal units of level a are the kernel of reduction on units modulo ℓᵃ. Equivalently ℓᵃ divides u − 1. At a = 0 the reduction has trivial target unit group.
imports.lean: def princ (a : ℕ) : Subgroup ℤ_[l]ˣ

imports.name: KStar.TotallyRealRoots.mem_princ
imports.statement: A unit belongs to the principal-unit subgroup at a exactly when ℓᵃ divides its difference from one in ℤℓ.
imports.lean: theorem mem_princ {a : ℕ} {u : ℤ_[l]ˣ} : u ∈ princ l a ↔ (l : ℤ_[l]) ^ a ∣ (u : ℤ_[l]) - 1

imports.name: KStar.TotallyRealRoots.isOpen_princ
imports.statement: The subgroup of principal units at each natural level is open in the ℓ-adic unit group.
imports.lean: theorem isOpen_princ (a : ℕ) : IsOpen (princ l a : Set ℤ_[l]ˣ)

imports.name: KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ_anti
imports.statement: If a ≤ b, every principal unit of level b is a principal unit of level a.
imports.lean: theorem princ_anti {a b : ℕ} (h : a ≤ b) : princ l b ≤ princ l a

imports.name: KStar.TotallyRealRoots.redPow_surjective
imports.statement: Every unit modulo ℓᵃ lifts to a unit in ℤℓ.
imports.lean: theorem redPow_surjective (a : ℕ) : Function.Surjective (redPow l a)

imports.name: Formalism.ConjugateSelfDual.G
imports.statement: G(F,Ω) is the group of F-algebra automorphisms of Ω. It is the absolute Galois group in this application because Ω is an algebraic closure of F.
imports.lean: abbrev G (F Ω : Type*) [Field F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω]

imports.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.ldataExists
imports.statement: For every number field, chosen algebraic closure and prime, compatible finite-place and cyclotomic-character data LData exist.
imports.lean: theorem ldataExists : LDataExists

imports.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.LocalFinitenessK
imports.statement: For a finite extension K of ℚℓ presented in the chosen ℓ-adic algebraic closure, and a finite discrete continuous ℤ/ℓʳ-representation of its absolute Galois group with r > 0, H⁰, H¹ and H² are finite and Hⁿ is trivial for n ≥ 3.
imports.lean: def LocalFinitenessK : Prop

imports.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.LocalTateDualityK
imports.statement: For the same finite local fields and finite discrete continuous modules at r > 0, H² of the cyclotomic coefficient has a linear identification with ℤ/ℓʳ. The degree (0,2), (1,1) in both evaluation orders, and (2,0) cup-product maps for the twisted dual are bijective.
imports.lean: def LocalTateDualityK : Prop

imports.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.PTShaAt
imports.statement: Under the Poitou–Tate case condition, the ℤℓ-length of the integral degree-two localization kernel at twist e + 1 equals the degree-one Sha length for the torsion twist −e.
imports.lean: def PTShaAt (D : LData F Ω l) (e : ℤ) : Prop

imports.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.QZ
imports.statement: QZ is ℚℓ modulo the ℤℓ-submodule given by the image of the inclusion ℤℓ → ℚℓ. It is the divisible ℓ-primary torsion group used as the target of characters and duals.
imports.lean: def QZ : Type

imports.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.instAddCommGroupQZ
imports.statement: Addition on ℚℓ/ℤℓ is the additive commutative group operation inherited from the module quotient.
imports.lean: instance : AddCommGroup (QZ l)

imports.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.instModulePadicIntQZ
imports.statement: The ℤℓ-module structure on ℚℓ/ℤℓ is the quotient module structure induced by multiplication on ℚℓ.
imports.lean: instance : Module ℤ_[l] (QZ l)

imports.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.instTopologicalSpaceQZ
imports.statement: Equip ℚℓ/ℤℓ with the discrete topology, denoted by bottom in Lean’s lattice of topologies.
imports.lean: instance : TopologicalSpace (QZ l)

imports.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.instDiscreteTopologyQZ
imports.statement: The selected topology on ℚℓ/ℤℓ is discrete by its definition.
imports.lean: instance : DiscreteTopology (QZ l)

imports.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.instIsTopologicalAddGroupQZ
imports.statement: Addition and negation on ℚℓ/ℤℓ are continuous for its discrete topology. This makes it a topological additive group.
imports.lean:
instance : IsTopologicalAddGroup (QZ l) where
  continuous_add := continuous_of_discreteTopology
  continuous_neg := continuous_of_discreteTopology

imports.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.LData
imports.statement: For a number field F, its closure Ω and a prime ℓ, the data specify a finite set S equal to the primes above ℓ, a valuation subring of Ω over each such prime and a character of the Galois group unramified outside S whose pullback is the full cyclotomic character. The choices enter the restriction maps in the Sha kernel.
imports.lean:
structure LData where

  S : Finset (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F))
  hS : (S : Set (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F))) = Above F l

  A : S → ValuationSubring Ω
  hA : ∀ v, IsPlaceOver (A v) v.1

  chi : GS Ω (S : Set (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F))) →* ℤ_[l]ˣ
  hchi : chi.comp (toGS Ω _) = cycZ F Ω l

imports.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.qzTw
imports.statement: On ℚℓ/ℤℓ, an element g of the unramified-outside-S Galois group acts by multiplication by χ(g)⁻ᵉ. Here e is an integer, so inversion and the minus sign are part of the coefficient convention.
imports.lean:
def qzTw (D : LData F Ω l) (e : ℤ) :
    Representation ℤ_[l] (GS Ω (D.S : Set (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F)))) (QZ l)

imports.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.zlTw
imports.statement: On ℤℓ, g acts through multiplication by χ(g)ⁿ with the integer exponent n. In VLen the chosen exponent n is e + 1.
imports.lean:
def zlTw (D : LData F Ω l) (n : ℤ) :
    Representation ℤ_[l] (GS Ω (D.S : Set (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F)))) ℤ_[l]

imports.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.Sha
imports.statement: Sha(D,e) is the submodule of H¹(G_S,ℚℓ/ℤℓ(−e)) consisting of the classes whose restrictions vanish on every decomposition subgroup selected by D at primes above ℓ. In cochains one takes continuous crossed homomorphisms modulo coboundaries, then the intersection of the kernels of those restriction maps. This is degree-one locally trivial Galois cohomology.
imports.lean: def Sha (D : LData F Ω l) (e : ℤ) : Submodule ℤ_[l] (H1 (qzTw D e))

imports.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.shaLen
imports.statement: Take the ℤℓ-module length of Sha(D,e), the degree-one kernel of localization for the negative twist. The value is an extended natural number, so the notation includes infinite length.
imports.lean: def shaLen (D : LData F Ω l) (e : ℤ) : ℕ∞

imports.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.VLen
imports.statement: VLen(D,e) is the ℤℓ-length of the entire group H²(G_S,ℤℓ(e + 1)). Here χ is the character in D, S is the set of primes above ℓ, and H² uses continuous two-cocycles modulo continuous coboundaries. The positive shift e + 1 is the dual twist paired with ℚℓ/ℤℓ(−e). The integral localization kernel sits inside H², and its inclusion yields the length inequality. VLen can have value infinity.
imports.lean: def VLen (D : LData F Ω l) (e : ℤ) : ℕ∞

imports.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.Sha2Zl
imports.statement: The integral degree-two Sha group is the submodule of H²(G_S,ℤℓ(e + 1)) whose restrictions to all decomposition groups chosen by D vanish.
imports.lean: def Sha2Zl (D : LData F Ω l) (e : ℤ) : Submodule ℤ_[l] (H2 (zlTw D (e + 1)))

imports.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.PTCase
imports.statement: PTCase holds if ℓ differs from two or F has zero real places. Thus at two one needs a totally complex field.
imports.lean: def PTCase (F : Type) [Field F] [NumberField F] (l : ℕ) : Prop

imports.name: ReciprocityTheory.Gal.continuous_cycZ
imports.statement: The ℓ-adic cyclotomic character is a continuous map from the absolute Galois group to the ℓ-adic units.
imports.lean: theorem continuous_cycZ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] : Continuous (cycZ F Ω l)

imports.name: ReciprocityTheory.Gal.NS
imports.statement: N_S is the closed normal subgroup generated by inertia at all primes outside S, using all valuation subrings lying over those primes.
imports.lean: def NS : Subgroup (G F Ω)

imports.name: ReciprocityTheory.Gal.normal_NS
imports.statement: N_S is normal. It is defined as the topological closure of a normal closure, and the closure of a normal subgroup is normal.
imports.lean: instance normal_NS : (NS Ω S).Normal

imports.name: ReciprocityTheory.Gal.GS
imports.statement: G_S is G(F,Ω)/N_S. Killing inertia outside S imposes the required finite-prime unramifiedness in the quotient.
imports.lean: abbrev GS

imports.name: ReciprocityTheory.Gal.Dec
imports.statement: The decomposition group of a valuation subring A of Ω is its stabilizer in the automorphisms of Ω over F.
imports.lean: def Dec (A : ValuationSubring (Ω)) : Subgroup (G F Ω)

imports.name: ReciprocityTheory.Gal.cycZ
imports.statement: The ℓ-adic cyclotomic character κ of G(F,Ω) is the usual action on ℓ-power roots of unity. It is obtained by composing the action on Ω with the cyclotomic character valued in ℤℓ-units.
imports.lean: def cycZ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] : G F Ω →* ℤ_[l]ˣ

imports.name: ReciprocityTheory.Gal.H2
imports.statement: H² is the quotient of the continuous two-cocycle submodule by the two-coboundaries, pulled back along the inclusion of cocycles in two-cochains.
imports.lean: abbrev H2

imports.name: ReciprocityTheory.Gal.Hn
imports.statement: At degree n use the quotient of the n-cocycles by the n-coboundaries pulled back to the cocycle submodule. This supplies the vanishing predicates in degrees at least three.
imports.lean: abbrev Hn (n : ℕ)

imports.name: ReciprocityTheory.Gal.Z1
imports.statement: The submodule of continuous one-cocycles consists of continuous functions satisfying f(gh) = f(g) + g f(h). Its module operations are pointwise.
imports.lean:
def Z1 : Submodule R (G → M) where
  carrier := {f | Continuous f ∧ ∀ g h, f (g * h) = f g + rho g (f h)}
  zero_mem' := ⟨continuous_const, fun g h => by simp⟩
  add_mem' := fun {f f'} hf hf' => ⟨hf.1.add hf'.1, fun g h => by
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, hf.2, hf'.2, map_add]; abel⟩
  smul_mem' c f hf := ⟨hf.1.const_smul c, fun g h => by
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, hf.2, map_smul, smul_add]⟩

imports.name: ReciprocityTheory.Gal.B1
imports.statement: One-coboundaries are the image of the degree-zero differential, taking a vector x to g ↦ g x − x.
imports.lean: def B1 : Submodule R (G → M)

imports.name: ReciprocityTheory.Gal.H1
imports.statement: H¹ is the quotient of continuous one-cocycles by the preimage of the one-coboundaries under the inclusion of cocycles in all functions.
imports.lean: abbrev H1

imports.name: ReciprocityTheory.Gal.Z2
imports.statement: The submodule of continuous two-cocycles consists of continuous functions of two group elements satisfying g f(h,k) − f(gh,k) + f(g,hk) − f(g,h) = 0.
imports.lean:
def Z2 : Submodule R (G × G → M) where
  carrier := {f | Continuous f ∧
    ∀ g h k, rho g (f (h, k)) - f (g * h, k) + f (g, h * k) - f (g, h) = 0}
  zero_mem' := ⟨continuous_const, fun g h k => by simp⟩
  add_mem' := fun {f f'} hf hf' => ⟨hf.1.add hf'.1, fun g h k => by
    have e1 := hf.2 g h k; have e2 := hf'.2 g h k
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, map_add]
    calc _ = (rho g (f (h, k)) - f (g * h, k) + f (g, h * k) - f (g, h)) +
          (rho g (f' (h, k)) - f' (g * h, k) + f' (g, h * k) - f' (g, h)) := by abel
      _ = 0 := by rw [e1, e2, add_zero]⟩
  smul_mem' c f hf := ⟨hf.1.const_smul c, fun g h k => by
    have e := hf.2 g h k
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, map_smul]
    rw [← smul_sub, ← smul_add, ← smul_sub, e, smul_zero]⟩

imports.name: ReciprocityTheory.Gal.B2
imports.statement: Two-coboundaries are the images of continuous one-cochains under the inhomogeneous group-cohomology differential.
imports.lean: def B2 : Submodule R (G × G → M)

imports.name: ReciprocityTheory.Gal.locFam
imports.statement: For each chosen prime v, the local family maps its decomposition group into G_S using its inclusion into the global Galois group and the unramified quotient.

imports.name: instance
imports.statement: If R acts on a discrete topological space M, then multiplication by each fixed scalar is continuous.
imports.lean:
instance (priority := 100) continuousConstSMul_of_discrete {R M : Type*} [SMul R M]
    [TopologicalSpace M] [DiscreteTopology M] : ContinuousConstSMul R M

imports.name: ReciprocityTheory.Gal.charRep
imports.statement: A unit-valued character χ defines a rank-one representation on the coefficient ring by sending g to χ(g) times the identity linear endomorphism.
imports.lean:
def charRep (χ : Γ →* Rˣ) : Representation R Γ R where
  toFun g := ((χ g : Rˣ) : R) • LinearMap.id
  map_one' := by ext; simp
  map_mul' g h := by ext; simp [mul_comm]
